review_description: Salesman was very knowledgeable and helpful.Communication was a little disappointing in the lead up to the installation, then the installation was delayed due to their work load but the installers were excellent and it all looks great.
I have had solar on my previous houses, I was impressed with the after care from these guys.

Finn your help and advise is impeccable when it comes to helping people make the right choices with solar, even though I did not go with one of your recommended suppliers due to a better deal,I could not have had the confidence to do that without your advice and information on solar.Thank you and RegardsCheryl
